title: 第十一章 现实世界电脑高手第十二章 大一小萌新
content_zh:
最新网址：王跃一听闫哥竟然说他玩游戏，这不是败坏他名声吗？咱虽然咸鱼了一点，但是却没有工作时间忙别的事情，好嘛！
“电脑太卡了，我得清理一下。”王跃也不给他解释什么，这个你给外行解释不清楚，还容易让人以为他吹牛。
肖奈装逼规则，能用事实说话就别鬼扯。又噼里啪啦一会，王跃一按回车，就看到黑乎乎的电脑屏幕，一行行的代码不断的跳跃。
没过多久，电脑屏幕又亮了起来，看起来电脑没有啥变化，围观的几个都撇了撇嘴角，各自忙各自的了。
王跃又重新开始画图，嗯，果然顺畅了许多。就看那电脑里的设计软件和几个其他辅助的工具之间不断切换，设计界面的图纸不断的完善。用了不到原来一半的时间，就完成了一个零件的绘制。
一时间王跃沉醉于，工作使我快乐，工作使我……想不出词了，反正，有三年没有干过机械设计的活王跃，虽然王跃保持着肖奈式高冷，但是，谁都能看出他挺happy的。
坐在他隔壁座位的办公室一支花徐静观察了他好一阵子后，毕竟女人天生的敏感，他总觉得王跃这一趟回来，明显的有很大的变化。
“王工，我看你打开网页瞬间就打开了，一点卡顿都没有，原来不是这样的啊！”徐静发现王跃打开网页查看资料的时候，竟然不卡，这太不符合公司现状了。“要不，你也给我整整呗！”
“这个啊，简单啊！你让开，分分钟的给你搞定！”王跃也不藏私，不一会就给解决了，拍拍屁股就准备潇潇洒洒的回到自己位置上去。
结果还没等他走开，其他同事一听说王跃竟然这么厉害，就都纷纷邀请王跃过去。
王跃无奈的，都不好拒绝，只能一个一个的去，这一忙活就到了下班时间了。
王跃一看下班时间到了，二话不说，合上电脑，断了电源，直接溜了。在楼下等车的功夫，王跃还在叹息，大意了啊，不该在公司嘚瑟的。
看着即将到站的22路公交车，王跃晃晃悠悠的，挤了上去。
回到自己的出租屋里，看着空荡荡的单间，突然想起微微世界里的宿舍，就拿起手机，打开大学宿舍群，发了一个信息。
“都干嘛呢？！”王跃在群里发了一个信息，结果，等了半天，没有一个人回复。
我去，不相信还炸不出你们，于是王跃发了一个20元的红包，结果不到5秒钟，红包全被抢了。
“我还以为，你们忙的，没时间抢红包呢！”王跃无力吐槽了。
“老四啊，你得理解哥哥们，我们都是有孩子老婆的，不像原来那么自由啊！”宿舍老大李静不以为耻，竟然还要插他插刀。
老二冯向阳也不忘记补刀，“我们也给你介绍过几个对象，你一个都看不上，都熬到快30了，还单着呢！”
“对啊，老四，你现在啥情况，有对象没，啥时候结婚啊，我们也是操碎了心！”老三于二彪很不厚道的又补一刀。

“得了吧，你们除了老二，其他都是相亲的对象，能相亲的。嫂子自己都要相亲，给我介绍的情况，你们又不是不知道啥情况！”王跃一听他们说介绍对象，也就无语凝噎。嫂子们介绍的，不是没有好的，只是人家也看不上王跃这样的咸鱼。
嫁汉嫁汉穿衣吃饭，从古到今都是这个道理，或者你帅的惊天地泣鬼神，否则都逃脱不了这个规则。
王跃这样的咸鱼，人家接触一段之后，就知道未来如果在一起是啥日子，哪里还会肯跟他继续耽误时间，又不是十七八岁有大把的时光。
“老四，你这话我们就不爱听了，哥哥们给你介绍的放在咱们系，都是系花一个级别了，你一个都没有把握住，怨得了别人吗？”老大李静也对宿舍这个兄弟无力吐槽了。
“老四，你这躺平的生活态度，从大学到现在一直都没变过，你继续这样，我感觉这辈子你就只有你的左手和右手了！”老三于二彪十分框定的继续撒盐。
“是啊！老四，大学里你的行情还不错，可是毕业后，你算算哪里有女的肯跟着你过日子！”老二冯向阳作为唯一一个自己谈对象，并且结果的，对于教育老四这个单身狗，他十分有底气。
“话说。老四，不知道他们，刚我确实看到你信息了，可是哥哥们都是老婆孩子热炕头的，就怕刺激你。”李静话头一转就问，“你这次是为了干啥，不过提前说好，介绍对象的事情免谈啊，为了你的事情，我都跪烂一箱方便面了！”
“我也是！”于二彪
“同上！”冯向阳
“没啥事，就是咱们好久没聚了，咱们啥时候聚聚！”王跃没再和兄弟们扯淡。
“聚啥啊聚，你嫂子说了，你不结果，不准我们跟你混！”老大李静
“是啊，你嫂子怕我们和你在一起久了，身上也有咸味了！”老二冯向阳
“我倒是可以去！不过就咱俩没啥意思，你赶紧找对象去吧！”老三于二彪其实一点也不彪啊！
王跃看了看手机的信息，一点也不想他们了，刚才想和他们聚的心情一定是幻觉。
王跃觉得就不应该给他们信息，于是往下翻翻，找到家庭爸妈三人的群组，然后准备发一个信息，不过仔细一想，还是打一个电话吧！毕竟三年多没听到老妈的唠叨了。
王跃这边电话一打过去，没一会，就接通了电话，和老爸说了几句，电话就被老妈拿了过去。一开始老妈还嘘寒问暖，让王跃心里暖洋洋的，觉得世上只有妈妈好！
可是没过几分钟，就听到妈妈话音一转，“小跃啊，你妈我这马上就退休了！我闲着也能给你看孩子了，你是不是也该结婚啦！你那边要是没有合适的，我这边托厂里的老姐妹给你看看？……”
后面说啥王跃没听清，反正一阵头大，我这还没到30呢，日子没法过了！最新网址：
content_en:
Latest website: When Wang Yue heard that Brother Yan said that he played games, wouldn't this ruin his reputation? Although we are a bit busy, we don’t have working time to do other things, okay!
"The computer is too stuck. I need to clean it up." Wang Yue didn't explain anything to him. You can't explain this to a layman, and it's easy for people to think that he is bragging.
Xiao Nai's pretense rule is, if you can speak with facts, don't talk nonsense. After a while of crackling, Wang Yue pressed Enter and saw a dark computer screen with lines of code constantly jumping.
Not long after, the computer screen lit up again. It seemed that the computer had not changed much. The onlookers curled their lips and everyone was busy with their own things.
Wang Yue started drawing again. Well, it turned out much smoother. It just depends on the continuous switching between the design software in the computer and several other auxiliary tools, and the drawings of the design interface are constantly improved. It took less than half the original time to complete the drawing of a part.
For a while, Wang Yue was obsessed with it. Work makes me happy, work makes me... I can't think of words. Anyway, Wang Yue hasn't done any mechanical design work for three years. Although Wang Yue maintains Xiao Nai's aloofness, everyone can see that he is quite happy.
Xu Jing, a flower in the office who was sitting next to him, observed him for a while. After all, women are naturally sensitive. He always felt that Wang Yue had obviously changed a lot after his return.
"Wang Gong, I saw that you opened the web page instantly without any lag at all. It turns out that's not the case!" Xu Jing found that when Wang Yue opened the web page to view information, there was no lag. This is very inconsistent with the current situation of the company. "Otherwise, you can also give me a full treatment!"
"This, it's simple! Get out of the way and I'll get it done for you in minutes!" Wang Yue didn't hide his secrets and solved the problem in a short while. He patted his butt and prepared to return to his place in a leisurely manner.
As a result, before he could leave, other colleagues all invited Wang Yue to come over when they heard that Wang Yue was so powerful.
Wang Yue was helpless and couldn't refuse, so he could only go one by one. After this busy work, it was time to get off work.
When Wang Yue saw that it was time to get off work, he closed the computer, cut off the power supply, and ran away without saying a word. While waiting for the bus downstairs, Wang Yue was still sighing. He was so careless. He shouldn't have been complaining in the company.
Looking at the No. 22 bus that was about to arrive at the stop, Wang Yue swayed and squeezed onto it.
Back in my rental house, looking at the empty single room, I suddenly remembered the dormitory in Weiwei World, so I picked up my phone, opened the university dormitory group, and sent a message.
"What are you doing?!" Wang Yue sent a message in the group, but after waiting for a long time, no one responded.
I'll go, I don't believe I can't blow you up, so Wang Yue handed out a 20 yuan red envelope. In the end, within 5 seconds, all the red envelopes were snatched.
"I thought you were too busy to grab red envelopes!" Wang Yue complained helplessly.
"Fourth brother, you have to understand brothers, we all have children and wives, we are not as free as before!" Li Jing, the boss of the dormitory, was not ashamed and even wanted to stab him.
The second eldest brother, Feng Xiangyang, also did not forget to finish the job, "We have also introduced you to several partners, but you don't like any of them. You are almost 30 years old and you are still single!"
"Yes, fourth child, what is your situation now? Do you have a partner? When will you get married? We are also worried!" Third child Yu Erbiao added unkindly.
"Come on, except for the second child, all of you are blind dates. You can go on a blind date. My sister-in-law wants to go on a blind date herself. It's not like you don't know what she introduced to me!" Wang Yue was speechless and choked up as soon as he heard what they said about the person they were introducing. It’s not that there are no good ones recommended by my sisters-in-law, but they don’t look down on salted fish like Wang Yue.
Marry a man, dress and eat with a man. This has been the truth from ancient times to the present. Or you may be so handsome that the world will be shocked.God, otherwise no one can escape this rule.
After getting to know someone like Wang Yue for a while, they will know what life will be like if they are together in the future. How can they continue to waste time with him? It is not like they have a lot of time at the age of seventeen or eighteen.
"Fourth brother, we don't like hearing what you are saying. The ones your brothers introduced to you are all at the same level as the department heads. You haven't grasped any of them. How can you blame others?" Li Jing, the boss, also complained about this brother in the dormitory.
"Fourth child, your attitude towards life has never changed since college. If you continue like this, I feel like you will only have your left and right hands in this life!" Third child Yu Erbiao continued to spread the salt very clearly.
"Yes! Fourth, your business was pretty good in college, but after graduation, where are the girls willing to live with you?" Feng Xiangyang, the second oldest, was the only one he talked to, and as a result, he was very confident in educating the single, Fourth.
"Speaking of which, Fourth Brother, I don't know about them. I did see your message just now, but my brothers are all in love with their wives and children, so they are afraid of irritating you." Li Jing asked as soon as the topic changed, "What are you doing this time, but we agreed in advance that there is no need to discuss the introduction of the person. Because of your affairs, I have knelt to pieces of a box of instant noodles!"
"Me too!" Yu Erbiao
"Same as above!" Feng Xiangyang
"It's nothing. It's just that we haven't gotten together for a long time. When can we get together!" Wang Yue stopped talking nonsense with his brothers.
"What are you doing? Ju, your sister-in-law said, if you don't bear fruit, we are not allowed to hang out with you!" Li Jing, the boss
"Yes, your sister-in-law is afraid that we will smell salty after being with you for a long time!" Feng Xiangyang, the second oldest child, said
"I can go! But it's not interesting for just the two of us, so hurry up and find a partner!" The third child and Er Biao are actually not cool at all!
Wang Yue looked at the messages on his phone and didn't miss them at all. His desire to get together with them just now must have been an illusion.
Wang Yue felt that he shouldn't give them information, so he scrolled down and found a group of three family members. He was about to send a message, but after thinking about it carefully, he decided to make a phone call! After all, I haven’t heard my mother’s nagging for more than three years.
As soon as Wang Yue called, he picked up the phone after a while. After a few words with his father, his mother took the phone over. At first, his mother even asked for help, which made Wang Yue feel warm in his heart. He felt that only his mother was good in the world!
But within a few minutes, I heard my mother's voice change, "Xiao Yue, your mother, I will retire soon! I can take care of your children in my spare time, so it's time for you to get married! If you don't have a suitable one over there, can I ask the old sisters in the factory to look after you?..."
Wang Yue didn't hear what was said after that. Anyway, I have a headache. I'm not even 30 yet, and I can't get through the day! Latest website:
